text: The purpose of this report is to provide the Board with information on a naming rights opportunity.

The Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Adopted the confidential instructions to staff set out in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (December 5, 2022) from President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live. 2. Authorized the public release of the confidential information in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (December 5, 2022) from President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live once the contract is executed and at the discretion of the President and Chief Executive Officer.
